name: dev
description: Build the change. A chained pipeline over one ai_docs/ workspace: brainstorm a design, analyze it from eight perspectives, break it into SLC phases, write a zero-context plan, pre-flight it, execute it in batches with reviewer subagents, a swarm or an arena of parallel candidates, check the implementation against the plan, and hand off. Discipline along the way: tdd, debug (with a hard-bug and performance-regression mode), verification-before-completion, doubt-driven-development, unlazy (with a lite mode), show-me-your-work. Finish the change: git worktrees, advanced git, finishing-a-development-branch, make-pr-easy-to-review, change-description, spec-driven-workflow. Adapted in part from obra/superpowers, HumanLayer, wshobson/agents, BMAD-METHOD and pstack; see NOTICE.md.
